Name: Fattening Fatty Farmer
Author: GoddessVirtue
Description:
This is a content pack for the Fattening Farmer Framework.
In order to get this pack running, first make sure you have SMAPI and the Fattening Farmer Framework installed.
Place this pack's main folder, "[CP] FatteningFattyFarmer" in your Mods folder, within your Stardew Valley install folder.
And you're done!

Bonus feature: This mod supports the GenericModConfigMenu by spacechase0.
If you also have GenericModConfigMenu installed, you'll be able to configure this mod from inside your game.
Just hit the gear icon from the main menu.

Thank you to Eyewatcher9 for creating the texture used by this content pack, and to 4ze for creating the texture the Fatty Farmer is based on.
Link to the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31260]Fatty Farmer[/url] mod
Link to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16054]Nude Farmer[/url], the mod Fatty Farmer is based on
